{"id":1929850404,"question_id":4065,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1771949947,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"268 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1929850404/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Sequences to K","memory":"119.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ti = tuple<int,int,int>;\n    using ll = long long;\n    map<ti , ll>dp;\n\n    ti factors(ll num)\n    {\n        int x = 0 , y = 0 , z = 0;\n        while(num % 2 == 0) x++ , num /= 2;\n        while(num % 3 == 0) y++ , num /= 3;\n        while(num % 5 == 0) z++ , num /= 5;\n\n        return {x , y , z};\n    }\n\n    int countSequences(vector<int>& nums, long long k) {\n        dp[{0 , 0 , 0}] = 1;\n\n        for(auto it : nums)\n        {\n            auto[fx , fy , fz] = factors(it);\n            map<ti , ll>ndp;\n            \n            for(auto it : dp)\n            {\n                auto[x , y , z] = it.first;\n                auto count = it.second;\n                //doing the operations here with powers\n                ndp[{x+fx , y+fy , z+fz}] += count;\n                ndp[{x-fx , y-fy , z-fz}] += count;\n                ndp[{x , y , z}] += count;\n            }\n            swap(ndp , dp);\n        }\n\n    int reqx = 0 , reqy = 0 , reqz = 0;\n    ll temp = k;\n    while(temp % 2 == 0) reqx++ , temp /= 2;\n    while(temp % 3 == 0) reqy++ , temp /= 3;\n    while(temp % 5 == 0) reqz++ , temp /= 5;\n\n    if(temp != 1) return 0;\n    return dp[{reqx , reqy , reqz}];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-sequences-to-k","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1740}
